record.question: Fill in the blanks: In any other case, a Government servant shall not accept any gift without the sanction of the Government if the value exceeds (a) Rupees ___________ in the case of Government servants holding any Group 'A' or Group 'B' post; and (b) Rupees ___________ in the case of Government servants holding any Group 'C' post.
record.explanation: The applicable CCS (Conduct) Rules thresholds are Rs. 5,000 for Group A/B and Rs. 2,000 for Group C, but the supplied item has no options, so no zero-based option index can be selected.
